title: Schwa: the Uh Vowel
rule: A vowel at the end of a syllable that is not stressed often says uh, like the a in about. We code that vowel with a schwa.
trickText: Say the word out loud. Which syllable is the loud, strong one? Find the quiet vowel at the start that just says uh. Put a schwa on it.
say: Today's case: the schwa. In the word about, the first sound is a quiet uh. That is a schwa. We put a schwa on the vowel that says uh.

example.say: Say about. The first part is quiet and says uh. The a is a schwa, so I put a schwa on the a.

activities.instruction: Find the quiet a that says uh. Put a schwa on it.

items.answer: a@ r o u n d
